# `aitbc reputation profile`

Get the reputation profile for an agent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc reputation profile [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent id. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc reputation profile --agent-id <agent_id>
```
